mira_marketing: Final dry run tomorrow 11:30am PT. Need poll copy, final run-of-show, and demo fallback confirmation.
li_prod: Bench bullets to call out: median latency ~75ms, 2.2x cost reduction using prefix cache + per-route batching, Dedicated pools keep tail latency predictable. Keep each bullet to one line on the slide.
dan_demo: I'll bring the demo laptop and a pre-recorded fallback clip. If the Private endpoint shows >500ms tail, we'll switch to clip at T+6. Clip uploaded: https://drive.redwood/fallbacks/demo_clip_trim.mp4
sophie_ops: Recording starts at 11:15. Please join 11:00 for mic checks. I'll post green/red statuses in the room chat.
nate_growth: Poll plan: minute 4 - "Primary infra pain?" options: latency / cost / scaling / observability. Minute 23 - "Sandbox invite?" yes/no. We'll use results for segmentation.
sched-bot: reminder: rehearsal scheduled in 10 hours. Resource check: private-demo pool healthy (3/6 GPUs free).
mira_marketing: Compact run-of-show:
```
11:15 - recording on + mic check
11:30 - welcome & goals (mira) - 3m
11:33 - benchmark narrative (li) - 7m
11:40 - live demo (dan) - 10m
11:50 - cost/ops deep dive (li) - 6m
11:56 - audience Q&A + poll review - 12m
12:08 - CTA & next steps (nate) - 2m
```
li_prod: Reminder for demo: minimize live token usage, prefer cached prefixes. If we hit failover, ops will announce and we proceed with the clip.
dan_demo: Confirmed. I'll have HOSTED_FALLBACK_KEY and PRIVATE_DEMO_KEY in env. Also local recording of steps.
sophie_ops: Mic check plan: speakers in room by 11:05. Quick 20s sound test each. I'll cue people with :white_check_mark: when good.
mira_marketing: Please react with :thumbsup: when you're set.
li_prod: ✅
dan_demo: ✅

mira_marketing: Thanks all. Will keep thread open for last-minute changes.
